title: Italians Killed in Iranian Strike on Kuwait. In 1990 Kuwait's Invasion Sparked a War #shorts
description:
This week Italy said two of its citizens were killed in an Iranian strike in Kuwait. In August 1990, Iraq invaded Kuwait in two days; a US-led coalition drove its army out in early 1991.
